seo_title: Pennsylvania Scholarships for African American Students
seo_description: Explore 6 scholarships for African American students in Pennsylvania with awards up to $5,000. Check deadlines and requirements.
intro: Finding financial support tailored for African American students in Pennsylvania can significantly ease the burden of educational costs. This catalog features 6 scholarships specifically aimed at this demographic, with award amounts ranging from approximately $250 to $5,000. Each scholarship has varying requirements and deadlines, so it’s important to review them closely to identify the best fit for your situation.
supporting: As you explore this list, consider comparing the award sizes and categories, which include STEM, education, and community-focused opportunities. Many of these scholarships do not require essays, making them more accessible. Keep an eye on the deadlines, as they vary and some are approaching quickly, ensuring you don’t miss out on potential funding.

faq.question: What types of scholarships are available for African American students in Pennsylvania?
faq.answer: This collection features six scholarships specifically for African American students in Pennsylvania, covering various categories such as STEM, education, community, and medicine. Each listing may have different eligibility criteria and award amounts, so it's important to review each one closely.

faq.answer: You can click on each scholarship listing to view detailed information, including award amounts and deadlines. Note that while many of these scholarships do not require essays, it's best to verify the specifics for each program as requirements can vary.

faq.question: Are there upcoming deadlines I should be aware of?
faq.answer: Yes, all six scholarships listed have deadlines, with at least one approaching within the next 45 days. Be sure to check the deadline for each scholarship individually to ensure you submit your application on time.

faq.question: What is the range of award amounts for these scholarships?
faq.answer: The award amounts for the scholarships in this category vary, with some offering as little as $250 and others up to $5,000. It's advisable to look at each listing for the specific amount and any additional details.
